historical_boundary: Historical practitioner texts document beliefs,procedures and reported experiences;they do not establish clairvoyance,telepathy,remote viewing or future-event access. Keep original author claims,subjective reports,ordinary reflection and creative prompts distinct.

feasibility.first_scope: One named edition-bounded guided symbolic reference plus manual imagery journal. Preserve raw user words and explicitly classify observed reflection,user-imagined imagery,uncertain/no imagery,and any generated prompt. No actual visual detector or animated field required for core.
feasibility.optical_conditions: Record chosen reflective surface,light/background and gaze/session context as declared inputs. Source suggestions are historical procedure,not a validated optical/psychological model. Do not prescribe unbroken staring;source permits blinking and avoids strain.
feasibility.interpretation: Direct source procedures receive locators;personal associations remain user attributed;editorial questions are compositional. No inferred factual events,entities,personality or emotions. Missing source dictionary content remains unsupported.
feasibility.creative_simulation: If useful later,a finite seeded prompt list can reuse independently framed integer primitives after inventory/rights/seed fixtures. Generated words/images are creative inspiration,never an observation made by the user or evidence from a crystal. No image-generation/UI prerequisite.
feasibility.reproducibility: Version exact source profile and procedural steps,raw user observations,condition fields,personal associations,optional finite prompt selection,hashes and full JSON/Markdown replay. Do not claim subjective perception itself is reproducible.
feasibility.rights: Use original factual notes now. PG USA-public-domain statement and its non-US/license notices remain explicit;authenticate edition/facsimile before whole-text ingestion. Scans,modern forewords/art and digital renderings have separate rights.
